card.name: "As a" after administer or suspended
card.fires_on: The word "as" or the "a"/"an" right after it, when a label says how something is given, swallowed or handled ("administer as", "swallowed as a", "suspended as a").

modes.label: The phrase "administer as"
modes.description: "as" after administer or administered, introducing the form or route of giving a drug.
modes.example: Do not administer<< as>> an intravenous bolus injection. •

modes.label: "As a" and "as an"
modes.description: The article "a" or "an" after "as", before a unit, whole capsule or injection type.
modes.example: Carvedilol phosphate extended-release capsules should be swallowed as<< a>> whole capsule.

card.plain: It marks the little word "as" or "a" in instructions saying in what form a drug is given or handled.
